rpx_assign_development_spirit = {
	rpx_calc_industrial_score = yes
	rpx_calc_industrial_ratio = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_ind_ratio
				value = 2
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_dev_industrial_giant
		log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] tier=industrial_giant"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_ind_ratio
				value = 1
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_dev_industrialized
		log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] tier=industrialized"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_ind_ratio
				value = 0.50
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_dev_emerging
		log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] tier=emerging"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_ind_ratio
				value = 0.25
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_dev_developing
		log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] tier=developing"
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = rpx_dev_agricultural
		log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] tier=agricultural"
	}
}

rpx_calc_industrial_ratio = {
	set_variable = { rpx_world_avg_tmp = global.rpx_world_avg_factory_score }
	set_variable = {
		rpx_ind_ratio = {
			value = rpx_ind_score
			divide = rpx_world_avg_tmp
		}
	}
	log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] world_avg_tmp=[?rpx_world_avg_tmp] ratio=[?rpx_ind_ratio]"
}

rpx_calc_industrial_score = {
	set_variable = {
		rpx_ind_score = {
			value = num_of_factories
			divide = num_owned_controlled_states
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = rpx_ind_score
		min = 0
		max = 5
	}
	log = "RPX [THIS.GetTag] factories=[?num_of_factories] states=[?num_owned_controlled_states] score=[?rpx_ind_score]"
}
